title: Publish vendor status event on contract approval
what: The approval service publishes a vendor status event when a contract is approved.
why: Vendors need the approval status without polling for it.
not_included: Contracts approved before this change get no event.
The approval API itself does not change.
risk_reason: It adds a new event that another service will consume.

criteria.text: Approving a contract publishes a vendor status event
No event is published when approval rolls back
Publishing can be switched off by config

decisions.text: Only new approvals publish an event. There is no backfill.
The event carries contract id, vendor id, status and timestamp.
Publishing ships switched off until the consumer is deployed.

assumptions: The outbox table can live in the approval service's own schema.
A delay of a few seconds between approval and the event is acceptable.

contract.summary: New event VendorStatusChanged on a new topic. Nothing existing changes shape.

items.name: vendor.status.enabled
items.change: new, default false, in every environment file

tests_expected_to_change.change: Two assertions on the approval result gain the outbox write.

repos.in_flight: No one else is working in these files.

slices.title: Add outbox table migration
slices.done_when: The migration runs on an empty and an existing database
slices.approach: Follow the existing audit_event migration. No existing table changes.

slices.title: Write status to outbox on approval
slices.done_when: An approval writes one outbox row, and a rollback writes none
slices.approach: Follow ApprovalAuditWriter, which already writes inside the approval transaction.

slices.title: Publish event from outbox relay
slices.done_when: The relay publishes each row once, and nothing when switched off
slices.approach: Use the internal framework's scheduled publisher. Add vendor.status.enabled to every environment file.

closing.title: Closing component and contract tests
closing.done_when: Approval publishes the event end to end, and the event matches its contract
closing.approach: Extend the existing approval component test. Add the provider contract test.

rollout: Merge and deploy with vendor.status.enabled set to false.
Switch publishing on per environment once the consumer is deployed.
To back out, switch publishing off. No data needs reverting.
